Flag.description:
One flag: its id, its request, its raiser and time, and its resolution.

``id`` names it, ``request`` is the comment and target it was raised with, ``by`` who raised
it (a person's recorded identity, the label record's own spelling) and ``at`` when;
``resolution`` is ``None`` while it is open. Construction validates every field
(``pydantic.ValidationError``).
Flag.title: Flag

FlagRequest.description:
A flag's comment, ``text``, and its ``target``, ``None`` for the image as a whole.

Construction validates every field (``pydantic.ValidationError``).
FlagRequest.title: FlagRequest

PointTarget.description: A flag's target at a pixel: ``point`` ``(x, y)`` and the ``subject`` annotated there.
PointTarget.title: PointTarget

ProposalTarget.description: A flag's target at a proposal: its ``bucket`` and its ``index`` in that bucket's document.
ProposalTarget.title: ProposalTarget

Resolution.description:
Who resolved a flag (a person) and when, the ``reply`` given, and whether by ``removed``.

``removed`` is whether the save that resolved it did so by removing the annotation it sat on.
Resolution.title: Resolution

tcip_annotation.flags._FLAGS_RECORD.description: One image's flags record: every flag raised on it, oldest first.
tcip_annotation.flags._FLAGS_RECORD.title: FlagsRecord

tcip_annotation.verdicts._VERDICT.description:
One decision on one proposal: which, what, who and when.

``proposal`` is the record's index in the bucket's document for the image, ``action`` what
the person decided, ``by`` who (a person's recorded identity, the label record's own
spelling) and ``at`` when. Construction validates every field (``pydantic.ValidationError``).
tcip_annotation.verdicts._VERDICT.title: Verdict

AssessmentEvidence.description:
The criteria one assessment measured, each member its criterion's evidence.

A count delivery measures ``count``, with ``reserved_region`` over a mosaic's reserved
regions or ``classifier`` for a positive state; a rank or value delivery ``scalar``; a
physical scale ``scale``. Refuses any other combination of members.
AssessmentEvidence.title: AssessmentEvidence

CheckpointAssessment.description:
An assessment of one checkpoint's numbers at one delivered kind.

``producer`` is the checkpoint's
(:attr:`~tcip_mcp.model_registry.VerifiedCheckpoint.producer`), ``execution`` the record of
the pass it ran under, and ``rationale`` why the assessment states the test settings it does.
CheckpointAssessment.title: CheckpointAssessment

ClassifierEvidence.description:
The classifier criterion's evidence over matched instances of the positive state.

``kappa`` is the holdout's chance-corrected agreement (``None`` when undefined) and
``kappa_floor`` the trait's floor; the positive-count bias is its present-scoped mean, standard
deviation and image count, held to ``positive_count_bias_tolerance`` of the
``typical_positive_count``; ``n_calibration`` and ``n_holdout`` count each side's items.
ClassifierEvidence.title: ClassifierEvidence

CountEvidence.description:
The count criterion's evidence: the fitted conf and the holdout judged at it.

``conf`` is the conf the count objective picked on the calibration curve, by the picker
``conf_derived_from`` names; ``localization`` the criterion both sides matched under;
``holdout_at_conf`` and ``calibration_at_conf`` each side's curve row at the conf, each with
its ``per_class`` rows. ``count_bias_tolerance_frac`` is the trait's fraction,
``typical_count`` the holdout's pooled typical per-image count and
``per_class_typical_count`` each class's, keyed as the curve rows key it; ``equivalence_z``
is the one-sided standard errors a bias is held to (:meth:`scope_equivalence`).
CountEvidence.title: CountEvidence

DisjointnessEvidence.description:
Whether a reference is held apart from itself and from the run that produced its model.

``holdout_shares_calibration`` lists the source digests its two sides share; ``training`` and
``selection`` what it shares with the producing run's training and validation sides, ``None``
when the run's membership is unknown or the reference is not of a run's model.
DisjointnessEvidence.title: DisjointnessEvidence

Execution.description:
One pass's complete execution record.

``conf`` and ``density`` (objects per pixel, which ``derivations.detection_cap`` scales to a
frame) are ``None`` for a checkpoint whose head is not a detector. ``masks`` is whether the
pass collects each detection's mask and ``mask_cut`` how they become rings (:class:`MaskCut`),
``None`` for a pass collecting no mask and for one keeping its masks uncut (:attr:`uncut`).
The tiled fields are ``None`` for an untiled pass. A record stating a tile edge without an
overlap, a conf without a density, or either reverse, refuses (``ValueError``) at
construction. ``sources`` names, per field whose value can come from more than one place,
where it came from, in :class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.slicing.TileGeometry`'s words
(``explicit`` for a value the caller stated, ``derived`` for the checkpoint's own recorded
one, ``native_ratio``), or the derivation or fit that produced it, by name; ``postprocess`` is
only ever stated. ``rationale`` is why the caller stated what it did, ``None`` when it stated
nothing. ``kind`` tells a pass's record from :class:`NoPass` (:data:`ProposalExecution`).
Execution.title: Execution

Key.description:
The identity of one record or log: which store, which root, which entry.

``root`` is the directory whose database holds the entry. ``parts`` is the identity inside the
store, ordered coarse to fine, so a prefix of it is a meaningful scan. Refuses (``BadKeyError``)
a key with no root, or with a store or a part that is not a non-empty string.
Key.title: Key

MaskCut.description:
How an instance segmentation head's soft masks become rings.

``mask_binarize`` is the probability a mask pixel is foreground at, refusing a value outside
``[0, 1]``, and ``vertex_spacing`` the pixels of each ring's perimeter per vertex its rings are
simplified to (``mask_contours.mask_to_polygon_rings``, zero keeping every contour vertex),
refusing a negative or non-finite value. Both are required.
MaskCut.title: MaskCut

Producer.description:
The checkpoint behind a model's predictions, and where it came from.

It is what :attr:`VerifiedCheckpoint.producer` states.
Producer.title: Producer

RasterIdentity.description:
One raster file's own content identity: header facts plus a seeded pixel checksum.

The checksum is deterministic.

Identifies one raster file, not a dataset. ``pixel_checksum`` is the discriminating term;
``width``/``height``/``num_channels``/``dtype`` travel alongside it.

``band_interpretations`` is present only when the backend that served this raster carries it
(GDAL) and is ``None`` otherwise. ``geotransform`` is optional, present only when the raster is
a georeferenced GeoTIFF whose affine tags this module can read.

``seed``/``window_size``/``max_windows``/``pixel_fraction`` are the sampling parameters that
produced ``pixel_checksum``.
RasterIdentity.title: RasterIdentity

RasterReference.description: A reference held out as the reserved regions of the mosaic ``raster_identity`` names.
RasterReference.title: RasterReference

ReferenceSample.description: One reference sample and the digest its source's pixels had when it was measured.
ReferenceSample.title: ReferenceSample

ReservedRegionEvidence.description:
How a mosaic's reserved regions were cut into bands for a count criterion.

``block_scale_px`` is the buffer between bands and ``block_scale_source`` what it was derived
from; ``k_cal`` and ``k_test`` the bands asked of each region, ``band_gt_counts`` each side's
ground-truth count per band, and ``density_uniformity_flags`` the bands whose count is an
outlier among its siblings.
ReservedRegionEvidence.title: ReservedRegionEvidence

RetainedFile.description:
One reference ground truth, its digest when retained, and its copy.

It holds the label document's key or the file's path it was read at, its
:func:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.selection.ground_truth_digest` when retained, and its copy
under the assessment's ``reference/``.
RetainedFile.title: RetainedFile

RunOverlap.description: What a reference shares with one side of its producing run: group keys, source digests.
RunOverlap.title: RunOverlap

Sample.description:
One sample of a selection.

It records where its pixels are, where its ground truth is, what it is grouped with, and
which side it landed on.

``member`` is the name a membership record names this sample by, as its admission resolved it
(:class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.label_queries.Admitted`). ``source`` is the image path, or
the ``.bandgroup`` manifest path standing in for a grouped capture, or the raster path when
the sample is a region of it. ``ground_truth`` is what answers for this sample: a per-image
label document's key, or the path of a mask raster or a table. ``row_key`` names this
sample's row inside a tabular ``ground_truth``, and is ``None`` when the whole file answers
for the sample.

``extent`` is the whole source or the region of it a within-image draw assigned.
``ground_truth_digest`` is the ground truth's
:func:`ground_truth_digest` when it was read, and ``read`` what that one read answered: the
decoded label document, or the table row's value; ``None`` for a mask and for a sample no
admission of this act has read; ``stored`` is what the store answered for that read
(``tcip_store.Versioned``).
``image`` is the logical image this act resolved ``source`` to (a
:class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.image_utils.BandGroupRef` for a grouped capture,
:func:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.label_queries.resolved`). None of the three is ever recorded
or compared.
Sample.title: Sample

ScalarEvidence.description:
The scalar criterion's evidence: ``criterion``'s ``score`` over ``n_holdout`` items.

``score`` is ``None`` when it is undefined or not finite, the failure naming which; ``floor``
is the trait's.
ScalarEvidence.title: ScalarEvidence

ScaleAssessment.description: An assessment of a physical scale: the ``scale`` it derived.
ScaleAssessment.title: ScaleAssessment

ScaleEvidence.description:
A physical scale's evidence: each reference image's implied scale and the checks on them.

``implied_scales`` holds each side's implied scale per reference image and
``tolerance_frac`` the trait's; the calibration and holdout means, the holdout's relative
dispersion and the scale's relative deviation from the holdout mean are ``None`` when either
side held too few references to derive them.
ScaleEvidence.title: ScaleEvidence

SelectionReference.description:
A reference drawn from the selection at ``selection_dir``.

``dataset_id`` is the identity id the samples' dataset root recorded when it was measured,
``None`` for a root that recorded none.
SelectionReference.title: SelectionReference

SourceRegion.description: A sample that is the half-open pixel ``rect`` ``(x0, y0, x1, y1)`` of its source.
SourceRegion.title: SourceRegion

TraitRevisionRef.description:
One trait revision: the trait, the revision's number and its entry's content hash.

The hash is ``traits.entry_sha256``.
TraitRevisionRef.title: TraitRevisionRef

WholeSource.description: A sample that is its whole source.
WholeSource.title: WholeSource

tcip_mcp.audit.AuditLine.description:
One audit log entry.

``arguments`` is held as the JSON form of what it was given
(``pydantic_core.to_jsonable_python``), a snapshot no later change to the given values
reaches; a value with no JSON form refuses. ``actor`` is absent for an act no person made,
the identity fields outside an agent session, and ``duration_ms`` and ``error`` for a line no
door call wrote. Any other key a writer adds, a caller's extra facts, is kept as an extra
field.
tcip_mcp.audit.AuditLine.title: AuditLine

Attribute.description:
One classification axis of a subject's instances.

``values`` are ordered, and a value's id is its position there; for an ``ordinal`` attribute
that order is the rank (severity 0 < 1 < 2). Construction validates every field
(``pydantic.ValidationError``): a known ``type`` and a non-empty list of distinct non-empty
names.
Attribute.title: Attribute

ClassScope.description:
The class space a run's ground truth was admitted under.

``subject`` is the object class a document admission read completion and targets for, and
``attributes`` every attribute the registry declares for it, each an
:class:`~tcip_mcp.subject_registry.Attribute` whose value ids are positions in its declared
order: ``None`` until the registry is read, empty for a subject that declares none. A mask
raster and a table row carry their own classes: the scope over them has every field
``None``. An empty subject is ``None``.
ClassScope.title: ClassScope

Execution.description:
One pass's complete execution record.

``conf`` and ``density`` (objects per pixel, which ``derivations.detection_cap`` scales to a
frame) are ``None`` for a checkpoint whose head is not a detector. ``masks`` is whether the
pass collects each detection's mask and ``mask_cut`` how they become rings (:class:`MaskCut`),
``None`` for a pass collecting no mask and for one keeping its masks uncut (:attr:`uncut`).
The tiled fields are ``None`` for an untiled pass. A record stating a tile edge without an
overlap, a conf without a density, or either reverse, refuses (``ValueError``) at
construction. ``sources`` names, per field whose value can come from more than one place,
where it came from, in :class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.slicing.TileGeometry`'s words
(``explicit`` for a value the caller stated, ``derived`` for the checkpoint's own recorded
one, ``native_ratio``), or the derivation or fit that produced it, by name; ``postprocess`` is
only ever stated. ``rationale`` is why the caller stated what it did, ``None`` when it stated
nothing. ``kind`` tells a pass's record from :class:`NoPass` (:data:`ProposalExecution`).
Execution.title: Execution

MaskCut.description:
How an instance segmentation head's soft masks become rings.

``mask_binarize`` is the probability a mask pixel is foreground at, refusing a value outside
``[0, 1]``, and ``vertex_spacing`` the pixels of each ring's perimeter per vertex its rings are
simplified to (``mask_contours.mask_to_polygon_rings``, zero keeping every contour vertex),
refusing a negative or non-finite value. Both are required.
MaskCut.title: MaskCut

NoPass.description: A proposal no inference pass produced.
NoPass.title: NoPass

Producer.description:
The checkpoint behind a model's predictions, and where it came from.

It is what :attr:`VerifiedCheckpoint.producer` states.
Producer.title: Producer

Proposed.description: The engine or agent that proposed a bucket's documents, by the name it stages under.
Proposed.title: Proposed

RasterIdentity.description:
One raster file's own content identity: header facts plus a seeded pixel checksum.

The checksum is deterministic.

Identifies one raster file, not a dataset. ``pixel_checksum`` is the discriminating term;
``width``/``height``/``num_channels``/``dtype`` travel alongside it.

``band_interpretations`` is present only when the backend that served this raster carries it
(GDAL) and is ``None`` otherwise. ``geotransform`` is optional, present only when the raster is
a georeferenced GeoTIFF whose affine tags this module can read.

``seed``/``window_size``/``max_windows``/``pixel_fraction`` are the sampling parameters that
produced ``pixel_checksum``.
RasterIdentity.title: RasterIdentity

tcip_mcp.buckets._BUCKET.description:
One published bucket, as its record states it.

``root`` is the dataset root its source images belong to and ``name`` the name it was
published under. ``producer`` is a checkpoint's sha256 and origin
(:attr:`~tcip_mcp.model_registry.VerifiedCheckpoint.producer`), or the engine or agent that
proposed the documents (:class:`Proposed`), which no class scope decodes (``scope`` empty).
``execution`` is the record of the pass that produced the documents, or, for a proposal, no
pass (:data:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.execution.ProposalExecution`). ``documents`` maps each
document's stem to the source file name it was predicted from, ``raster_path`` is the
raster as stored against the project (:meth:`raster`), and ``published_at`` the instant its
publication committed.
tcip_mcp.buckets._BUCKET.title: Bucket

tcip_mcp.dataset_layout.DatasetRecord.description:
A dataset's identity document, ``dataset.json``: its crop, its minted id, its fingerprint.

``fingerprint`` is ``None`` for a dataset that yielded none when it was registered.
tcip_mcp.dataset_layout.DatasetRecord.title: DatasetRecord

tcip_mcp.experiments.CancelRequest.description: The first cancellation request of a run or sweep: the instant it was made.
tcip_mcp.experiments.CancelRequest.title: CancelRequest

RunCheckpoint.description: The checkpoint a completed run selected: its path and the sha256 of its bytes.
RunCheckpoint.title: RunCheckpoint

tcip_mcp.experiments.FinalStatus.description:
How a run or sweep ended: its state, the instant, the error behind it, and its checkpoint.

``checkpoint`` is ``None`` for a sweep and for a run that selected none.
tcip_mcp.experiments.FinalStatus.title: FinalStatus

tcip_mcp.experiments.MetricsRow.description:
One metrics-log row: the stamps its writer lays beside its logged values.

Every row carries its ``epoch`` and the ``timestamp`` it landed at; a per-batch row also its
training ``step``, ``None`` on an epoch row. Every logged value is a finite JSON value.
tcip_mcp.experiments.MetricsRow.title: MetricsRow

Attribute.description:
One classification axis of a subject's instances.

``values`` are ordered, and a value's id is its position there; for an ``ordinal`` attribute
that order is the rank (severity 0 < 1 < 2). Construction validates every field
(``pydantic.ValidationError``): a known ``type`` and a non-empty list of distinct non-empty
names.
Attribute.title: Attribute

BoundSelection.description: The selection a bound run bound: its directory, its digest and whether the run redrew.
BoundSelection.title: BoundSelection

BoundSplit.description:
``data.split`` bound to the selection recorded at ``selection_dir``.

Its train and val sides are as recorded, or, with a ``seed`` stated, redrawn inside them at
it. The draw's reason is the selection's own record.
BoundSplit.title: BoundSplit

ClassScope.description:
The class space a run's ground truth was admitted under.

``subject`` is the object class a document admission read completion and targets for, and
``attributes`` every attribute the registry declares for it, each an
:class:`~tcip_mcp.subject_registry.Attribute` whose value ids are positions in its declared
order: ``None`` until the registry is read, empty for a subject that declares none. A mask
raster and a table row carry their own classes: the scope over them has every field
``None``. An empty subject is ``None``.
ClassScope.title: ClassScope

ContractDims.description:
The dimensions a synthetic smoke batch of a run is shaped at.

They are :func:`resolve_contract_dims`': ``in_chans``, the band count; ``img_size``, the
``(width, height)`` of the frame it trains on; ``num_classes``, its class or rank count;
``attributes``, the attribute records its detector heads read. A run has no key for a
dimension it has none of.
ContractDims.title: ContractDims

DataSpec.description:
``data``: where a run's samples are and how they split.

It also holds what the run's resolution records beside them (``scope`` and the sizes). A key
outside these fields refuses by name, and so does a ``tiling`` beside a ``dataset_source``.
DataSpec.title: DataSpec

DatasetIdentity.description: The dataset a run's data block names: its id and its fingerprint, each ``None`` unset.
DatasetIdentity.title: DatasetIdentity

DatasetSourceSchema.description:
A bespoke dataset builder.

A key outside these fields refuses by name, and so does a ``builder_kwargs`` naming a value
the platform hands (:class:`DatasetContext`).
DatasetSourceSchema.title: DatasetSourceSchema

DetectorGeometry.description:
A detector's input scale and anchors, the four keyword values the platform hands a builder.

They are ``min_size`` and ``max_size``, the resize bounds, ``anchor_base_size``, the anchor
size of the finest pyramid level, each coarser level doubling it, and ``aspect_ratios`` (h/w),
the ratios every level's anchors take; ``source`` is the label of the derivation that gave
them (``derivations.derive_detector_geometry``) or the statement of them.

anyOf.const: the frame's own short and long edges as min_size and max_size, the p10 of the objects' characteristic sizes floored to a pixel as the finest level's anchor size, and gt_aspect_ratios over their boxes

DetectorGeometry.title: DetectorGeometry

DrawnSplit.description:
``data.split`` a run draws itself at ``seed``.

Each side but ``train`` is drawn at its stated ``<side>_ratio`` (zero draws no such side,
``train`` the remainder), balanced by foreground count when ``stratify_foreground``, grouped
by ``grouping``: a named policy, or an explicit ``{<capture>/<stem>: group_key}`` map covering
every member.
DrawnSplit.title: DrawnSplit

Environment.description:
The platform git commit and the Python, ML library and CUDA versions a run ran under.

Each but ``python`` is ``None`` when it cannot be resolved; ``cuda`` is ``None`` on a CPU-only
or torch-less environment.
Environment.title: Environment

Key.description:
The identity of one record or log: which store, which root, which entry.

``root`` is the directory whose database holds the entry. ``parts`` is the identity inside the
store, ordered coarse to fine, so a prefix of it is a meaningful scan. Refuses (``BadKeyError``)
a key with no root, or with a store or a part that is not a non-empty string.
Key.title: Key

LaunchContract.description:
The model contract a launch records on its run.

``subject`` names what was checked and ``gating`` whether it gates the launch;
``batch_source`` is the batch that drove it (``"dataset"`` or ``"synthetic"``), ``dims`` a
synthetic batch's dimensions (``None`` for a dataset batch), ``issues`` and
``gradient_magnitudes`` the :class:`ContractReport`'s, and ``overfit_check`` the
:func:`overfit_check` report, ``None`` when none ran.
LaunchContract.title: LaunchContract

OverfitReport.description:
What :func:`overfit_check` found.

``losses`` is each step's loss, and ``initial`` and ``final`` the first and last, ``None``
with no step taken; a loss that was not finite is ``None`` at its position. ``issue`` says
why the check did not pass, ``None`` when it did. Refuses a non-finite number.
OverfitReport.title: OverfitReport

Partition.description:
The partition a run's resolution records.

It holds the draw's ``seed`` (``None`` for a route that drew nothing) and resolved
``group_by``, every sample the run bound on the side it landed on, with the ground-truth
digest it carries, ``selection``, the selection a bound run bound, ``None`` for a run that
drew its own, and ``spatial``, a within-image split's regions
(:func:`spatial_single_source_split`), ``None`` otherwise.
Partition.title: Partition

RangeTest.description:
A learning-rate range test of one stage of its config, and the ramp it ran under.

The run probes ``stage``, an index into its config's ``stages``. Its head group's rate starts
at ``ramp_low`` and every group's rate is multiplied by one factor per optimizer step,
reaching ``ramp_high`` at step ``batches``; it stops at the first step whose loss is not
finite or whose loss, exponentially smoothed with ``smoothing`` the weight of each new loss,
exceeds ``divergence`` times the least smoothed loss so far (``pipelines.training.lr_range``).
Refuses a ramp whose ``ramp_low`` is not below its ``ramp_high``.
RangeTest.title: RangeTest

RasterIdentity.description:
One raster file's own content identity: header facts plus a seeded pixel checksum.

The checksum is deterministic.

Identifies one raster file, not a dataset. ``pixel_checksum`` is the discriminating term;
``width``/``height``/``num_channels``/``dtype`` travel alongside it.

``band_interpretations`` is present only when the backend that served this raster carries it
(GDAL) and is ``None`` otherwise. ``geotransform`` is optional, present only when the raster is
a georeferenced GeoTIFF whose affine tags this module can read.

``seed``/``window_size``/``max_windows``/``pixel_fraction`` are the sampling parameters that
produced ``pixel_checksum``.
RasterIdentity.title: RasterIdentity

ResolvedInput.description:
What a run's input resolved to at launch, as ``split_construction``'s resolution records it.

That is its data block, the geometry read off its training frames, its ``partition`` (the
resolution's own record of its samples and how they were drawn,
``split_construction.Partition``) and the confirmed trait revision it trains for, ``None``
for none.
ResolvedInput.title: ResolvedInput

Sample.description:
One sample of a selection.

It records where its pixels are, where its ground truth is, what it is grouped with, and
which side it landed on.

``member`` is the name a membership record names this sample by, as its admission resolved it
(:class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.label_queries.Admitted`). ``source`` is the image path, or
the ``.bandgroup`` manifest path standing in for a grouped capture, or the raster path when
the sample is a region of it. ``ground_truth`` is what answers for this sample: a per-image
label document's key, or the path of a mask raster or a table. ``row_key`` names this
sample's row inside a tabular ``ground_truth``, and is ``None`` when the whole file answers
for the sample.

``extent`` is the whole source or the region of it a within-image draw assigned.
``ground_truth_digest`` is the ground truth's
:func:`ground_truth_digest` when it was read, and ``read`` what that one read answered: the
decoded label document, or the table row's value; ``None`` for a mask and for a sample no
admission of this act has read; ``stored`` is what the store answered for that read
(``tcip_store.Versioned``).
``image`` is the logical image this act resolved ``source`` to (a
:class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.image_utils.BandGroupRef` for a grouped capture,
:func:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.label_queries.resolved`). None of the three is ever recorded
or compared.
Sample.title: Sample

SnapshotCopy.description:
One declared file's copy in a run's source snapshot.

``file`` is its path in the run directory (under :data:`SNAPSHOT_DIR`), ``sha256`` its content
digest and ``bytes`` its size.
SnapshotCopy.title: SnapshotCopy

SourceRegion.description: A sample that is the half-open pixel ``rect`` ``(x0, y0, x1, y1)`` of its source.
SourceRegion.title: SourceRegion

SourceSnapshot.description:
A run's source snapshot record (:func:`snapshot_model_source`).

``files`` holds each declared file's copy, keyed by the file's stored path
(``registry_paths.stored_path`` against the run's project).
SourceSnapshot.title: SourceSnapshot

SpatialManifest.description:
The within-image split a run's resolution drew over its one source's tile lattice.

The split is ``split_construction.spatial_single_source_split``'s, recorded in its resolved
partition: each side's half-open pixel regions, the region identities its train and val tiles
carry, the buffer it was drawn at (the lattice is the run's ``data.tiling``), the fractions
it requested, the tiles each side kept and dropped, and the raster it was drawn over
(``split_construction.raster_identity``).
SpatialManifest.title: SpatialManifest

Standalone.description: A run launched on its own.
Standalone.title: Standalone

TilingSpec.description:
``data.tiling``, stated for a run that tiles its loader (:func:`run_tiling`).

It holds the ``datasets.TiledDetectionDataset`` options it states (an unstated edge and
overlap derived, an unstated sliver fraction derived by the tiler), whether a tile holding no
object trains (``skip_empty``), and a within-image spatial split's ``buffer``.
TilingSpec.title: TilingSpec

TrainGeometry.description:
What a run's resolution read off the frames its train dataset serves.

``native_size`` is the one ``(width, height)`` every training frame of a run the platform
resolved untiled shares (``None`` when sizes differ or the run tiles); ``object_density``, a
detector's objects per pixel over the regions it trains on; and ``detector``, the geometry its
builder is handed (each ``None`` for any other head).
TrainGeometry.title: TrainGeometry

TraitRevisionRef.description:
One trait revision: the trait, the revision's number and its entry's content hash.

The hash is ``traits.entry_sha256``.
TraitRevisionRef.title: TraitRevisionRef

TrialPoint.description: A trial of the sweep its directory lies beneath, and the point it was sampled at.
TrialPoint.title: TrialPoint

WholeSource.description: A sample that is its whole source.
WholeSource.title: WholeSource

_Stated.description:
A block a config states.

A key outside its fields refuses by name, and ``rationale`` carries why the block states what
it does.
_Stated.title: _Stated

tcip_mcp.experiments.RunRecord.description:
A run's ``run.json``: its input and what that input resolved to, written once at launch.

It holds the instant it was created, its launch ``config`` as the config records itself,
``resolved`` (``None`` for a sweep trial whose sampled point was refused at its admission or
failed to resolve), the ``environment`` it ran in, the ``dataset`` its data block names, the
``source`` snapshot record its admission took, the run it was relaunched from and the
checkpoint it resumes from, its wall clock, the model contract preflight proved, and whether
it was launched on its own, as a sweep's trial at a sampled point or as a range test.
tcip_mcp.experiments.RunRecord.title: RunRecord

SweepInput.description:
What a sweep was asked for: its search, its trial budget and the config its trials vary.

``base_config`` is the base training config each trial modifies and ``param_space`` the
space its points are drawn from (``hpo.space_axes``); ``split_draw_seeds`` names the seeds
each point is drawn under, one draw per seed, ``None`` for a single draw.
SweepInput.title: SweepInput

TraitRevisionRef.description:
One trait revision: the trait, the revision's number and its entry's content hash.

The hash is ``traits.entry_sha256``.
TraitRevisionRef.title: TraitRevisionRef

tcip_mcp.experiments.SweepRecord.description:
A sweep's ``sweep.json``, written once before its first trial.

It holds the instant it was created, the confirmed trait revision its trials train for
(``None`` for none) and its :class:`SweepInput`.
tcip_mcp.experiments.SweepRecord.title: SweepRecord

tcip_mcp.experiments._Launched.description: The run a ``launch_training`` audit line's arguments name.
tcip_mcp.experiments._Launched.title: _Launched

DetectorGeometry.description:
A detector's input scale and anchors, the four keyword values the platform hands a builder.

They are ``min_size`` and ``max_size``, the resize bounds, ``anchor_base_size``, the anchor
size of the finest pyramid level, each coarser level doubling it, and ``aspect_ratios`` (h/w),
the ratios every level's anchors take; ``source`` is the label of the derivation that gave
them (``derivations.derive_detector_geometry``) or the statement of them.

anyOf.const: the frame's own short and long edges as min_size and max_size, the p10 of the objects' characteristic sizes floored to a pixel as the finest level's anchor size, and gt_aspect_ratios over their boxes

DetectorGeometry.title: DetectorGeometry

TrainGeometry.description:
What a run's resolution read off the frames its train dataset serves.

``native_size`` is the one ``(width, height)`` every training frame of a run the platform
resolved untiled shares (``None`` when sizes differ or the run tiles); ``object_density``, a
detector's objects per pixel over the regions it trains on; and ``detector``, the geometry its
builder is handed (each ``None`` for any other head).
TrainGeometry.title: TrainGeometry

_Stated.description:
A block a config states.

A key outside its fields refuses by name, and ``rationale`` carries why the block states what
it does.
_Stated.title: _Stated

tcip_mcp.model_registry.CheckpointStamp.description:
The stamp a checkpoint carries beside its weights, as ``checkpoint_stamp`` writes it.

That is ``generic_trainer.checkpoint_stamp``: its run's ``config`` as it records itself, its
paths stored against the run's project, the digest of the source ``snapshot`` its run took
(``SourceLayout.snapshot``), and the ``geometry`` its run read off its training frames.
tcip_mcp.model_registry.CheckpointStamp.title: CheckpointStamp

RegistryEntry.description:
One checkpoint a project can load, under the name and tags it was registered with.

``name`` is the run's id for a run's own entry and the registered name for a foreign one.
``checkpoint_path`` is as stored (:func:`~tcip_mcp.registry_paths.checkpoint_registry_path_for`)
and ``sha256`` the digest of its bytes. ``metrics`` are the ones its registration asserted: a
caller's for a foreign checkpoint, none for a run's own entry, whose metrics its checkpoint
carries (:func:`entry_facts`).
RegistryEntry.title: RegistryEntry

tcip_mcp.model_registry.RegistryIndex.description: The project's registered-model index: its foreign checkpoints, one entry per sha256.
tcip_mcp.model_registry.RegistryIndex.title: RegistryIndex

tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.band_groups.Band.description:
The record a ``.bandgroup`` manifest holds.

``bands`` maps each band's name to its file's name beside the manifest, at least one, in the
order pixels are stacked into ``[H, W, C]``; a name holding a directory part (either slash)
is refused. ``source`` names the strategy that formed the group. ``identity_tolerance``
holds, per identity signal the group was checked on, the gap it was checked against, empty
when none was. ``central_wavelength_nm`` is each band's stated wavelength, ``None`` when
nothing stated one.
tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.band_groups.Band.title: BandGroupManifest

Attribute.description:
One classification axis of a subject's instances.

``values`` are ordered, and a value's id is its position there; for an ``ordinal`` attribute
that order is the rank (severity 0 < 1 < 2). Construction validates every field
(``pydantic.ValidationError``): a known ``type`` and a non-empty list of distinct non-empty
names.
Attribute.title: Attribute

ClassScope.description:
The class space a run's ground truth was admitted under.

``subject`` is the object class a document admission read completion and targets for, and
``attributes`` every attribute the registry declares for it, each an
:class:`~tcip_mcp.subject_registry.Attribute` whose value ids are positions in its declared
order: ``None`` until the registry is read, empty for a subject that declares none. A mask
raster and a table row carry their own classes: the scope over them has every field
``None``. An empty subject is ``None``.
ClassScope.title: ClassScope

Key.description:
The identity of one record or log: which store, which root, which entry.

``root`` is the directory whose database holds the entry. ``parts`` is the identity inside the
store, ordered coarse to fine, so a prefix of it is a meaningful scan. Refuses (``BadKeyError``)
a key with no root, or with a store or a part that is not a non-empty string.
Key.title: Key

Sample.description:
One sample of a selection.

It records where its pixels are, where its ground truth is, what it is grouped with, and
which side it landed on.

``member`` is the name a membership record names this sample by, as its admission resolved it
(:class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.label_queries.Admitted`). ``source`` is the image path, or
the ``.bandgroup`` manifest path standing in for a grouped capture, or the raster path when
the sample is a region of it. ``ground_truth`` is what answers for this sample: a per-image
label document's key, or the path of a mask raster or a table. ``row_key`` names this
sample's row inside a tabular ``ground_truth``, and is ``None`` when the whole file answers
for the sample.

``extent`` is the whole source or the region of it a within-image draw assigned.
``ground_truth_digest`` is the ground truth's
:func:`ground_truth_digest` when it was read, and ``read`` what that one read answered: the
decoded label document, or the table row's value; ``None`` for a mask and for a sample no
admission of this act has read; ``stored`` is what the store answered for that read
(``tcip_store.Versioned``).
``image`` is the logical image this act resolved ``source`` to (a
:class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.image_utils.BandGroupRef` for a grouped capture,
:func:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.label_queries.resolved`). None of the three is ever recorded
or compared.
Sample.title: Sample

SourceRegion.description: A sample that is the half-open pixel ``rect`` ``(x0, y0, x1, y1)`` of its source.
SourceRegion.title: SourceRegion

WholeSource.description: A sample that is its whole source.
WholeSource.title: WholeSource

tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.selection._SELEC.description:
A drawn partition: its samples, the scope they were admitted under, and how it was drawn.

How it was drawn is its ``seed`` and grouping, ``ratios``, the share each side was requested
at (``split_construction.check_shares``'s answer), whether it was balanced by foreground
count (``stratify_foreground``), and ``rationale``, why it was drawn so.

``scope`` is the class space the draw admitted through, empty for a draw over ground truth no
registry scopes, a mask raster or a table row.
tcip_mcp.pipelines.data.selection._SELEC.title: Selection

StoredLabelKey.description: A label document's key as a record stores it.
StoredLabelKey.title: StoredLabelKey

tcip_mcp.pipelines.delivery_events_schem.description:
The breeder's recorded act of shipping one unvalidated result.

It holds its id, who did it and why (both required non-empty; a blank one refuses,
``ValueError``), the digest of the result it was given for, and when it was recorded.
tcip_mcp.pipelines.delivery_events_schem.title: Acknowledgment

Acknowledgment.description:
The breeder's recorded act of shipping one unvalidated result.

It holds its id, who did it and why (both required non-empty; a blank one refuses,
``ValueError``), the digest of the result it was given for, and when it was recorded.
Acknowledgment.title: Acknowledgment

AnsweredScale.description: The physical-scale assessment a delivery named, which answers for its unit and buckets.
AnsweredScale.title: AnsweredScale

CanopySegmentDisclosure.description:
The ``plant_mapping`` of an orthomosaic delivery's canopy-segment regime.

Names the plant registry and the raster identity, plus the canopy document this delivery read
its boundaries from, the resolved segment-to-plant ties, the position error in meters the ties
were held to, and the registry plants attribution excluded, by name and by reason: outside the
raster's frame, inside no segment, within the position error of its segment's boundary, or
inside a segment whose own detection was ambiguous
(:data:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.postprocessing.segment_attribution.SegmentAssignment`'s
``"overlapping_segments"`` source). Every key is required.
CanopySegmentDisclosure.title: CanopySegmentDisclosure

CanopySegmentsDocument.description:
The label document a canopy-segment delivery read its boundaries from.

It is named by its capture and stem under the delivered bucket's dataset root and by the
version it was read at.
CanopySegmentsDocument.title: CanopySegmentsDocument

DerivedRadius.description: A date's match radius (meters) derived from the positioning error its photographs report.
DerivedRadius.title: DerivedRadius

MatchTolerance.description:
A nearest-neighbor match tolerance (meters) and the branch of its resolution behind it.

The branch is :func:`resolve_nn_tolerance_m`'s.
MatchTolerance.title: MatchTolerance

PlantMappingDisclosure.description:
The ``plant_mapping`` a phenology delivery attributed detections through.

It holds the mapping's own identity, ``verify_mapping_inputs``'s :class:`MappingVerification`,
and this delivery's own count of captures naming no plant over its ``dates_delivered``.
PlantMappingDisclosure.title: PlantMappingDisclosure

PlantRegistryDisclosure.description:
The ``plant_mapping`` of an orthomosaic delivery's nearest-neighbor regime.

It names the plant registry the regime read, the raster identity every count in the delivery
is attributed through, the tolerance it matched detections under, this delivery's own count
of detections attributed to no plant over the delivered raster, and the registry plants the
raster's own frame does not picture at all, by name. Every key is required.
PlantRegistryDisclosure.title: PlantRegistryDisclosure

PlantRegistryReference.description: A registered plant registry (:class:`PlantRegistry`) by name and content digest.
PlantRegistryReference.title: PlantRegistryReference

Producer.description:
The checkpoint behind a model's predictions, and where it came from.

It is what :attr:`VerifiedCheckpoint.producer` states.
Producer.title: Producer

RasterIdentity.description:
One raster file's own content identity: header facts plus a seeded pixel checksum.

The checksum is deterministic.

Identifies one raster file, not a dataset. ``pixel_checksum`` is the discriminating term;
``width``/``height``/``num_channels``/``dtype`` travel alongside it.

``band_interpretations`` is present only when the backend that served this raster carries it
(GDAL) and is ``None`` otherwise. ``geotransform`` is optional, present only when the raster is
a georeferenced GeoTIFF whose affine tags this module can read.

``seed``/``window_size``/``max_windows``/``pixel_fraction`` are the sampling parameters that
produced ``pixel_checksum``.
RasterIdentity.title: RasterIdentity

SegmentTieDisclosure.description:
One resolved segment-to-plant tie: the attribution claim itself, and its derived margin.

The margin
(:class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.postprocessing.segment_attribution.TiedSegment.clearance_m``) is
what a displaced registry position would have to exceed to leave this segment.
SegmentTieDisclosure.title: SegmentTieDisclosure

ShippedAcknowledged.description: A delivery shipped unvalidated under a breeder's acknowledgment.
ShippedAcknowledged.title: ShippedAcknowledged

ShippedValidated.description: A delivery every finding of which the gate validated, shipped under no acknowledgment.
ShippedValidated.title: ShippedValidated

StatedRadius.description: A match radius (meters) a mapping build states for its captures, and how it is known.
StatedRadius.title: StatedRadius

UnansweredScale.description:
The physical-scale assessment a delivery named, which answers for nothing, and why.

``reason`` is the sentence the gate refused the delivery with for this assessment.
UnansweredScale.title: UnansweredScale

UnvalidatedBucket.description:
A delivered bucket nothing validates, and why.

The bucket is named as a :class:`ValidatedBucket` is, beside the assessment it was published
under, ``None`` when it names none.
UnvalidatedBucket.title: UnvalidatedBucket

ValidatedBucket.description:
A delivered bucket the assessment it was published under validates.

The bucket is named by its dataset root, its name and its capture date (``None`` for an
undated bucket).
ValidatedBucket.title: ValidatedBucket

tcip_mcp.pipelines.delivery_events_schem.description:
The stored per-delivery record.

It holds the trait revision it shipped under (its
:class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.schemas.TraitRevisionRef` fields), what shipped and of which kind,
from which producer, what the gate found per bucket and for the physical-scale assessment the
delivery named (:data:`ScaleRead`, ``None`` when it named none), and how it shipped
(:data:`Shipped`).
tcip_mcp.pipelines.delivery_events_schem.title: DeliveryEventRecord

Detection.description:
One detection in full-frame pixels.

It holds its xyxy ``box``, ``score``, 1-indexed ``label``, ``attributes`` (one value id per
attribute the checkpoint's recorded dimensions declare, none where they declare none) and
``mask``, its flat ``[x0, y0, x1, y1, ...]`` polygons or ``None``. A pass's detection carries
``None`` under an execution cutting no mask and an empty list for a cut mask that binarized
to nothing; a raster pass's progress row
(:class:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.inference.generic_predictor.SliceBatch`) carries ``None`` for
both.
Detection.title: Detection

tcip_mcp.pipelines.inference.generic_pre.description:
Lattice slices a sliced pass predicted, with their shifted predictions.

``slices`` are ``(x0, y0, x1, y1)`` (:func:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.slicing.slice_lattice`) and
``predictions`` their full-frame detections
(:func:`~tcip_mcp.pipelines.slicing.prediction_rows`): one tile batch's, or every recorded
batch's together as an interrupted pass's prior.
tcip_mcp.pipelines.inference.generic_pre.title: SliceBatch

Assignment.description:
One image's plant assignment, the image named by its file name in its date folder.

``distance_m`` is the GPS distance in meters from the capture to the plant its matching
measured (the plant assigned, or for an unmapped capture the nearest one), ``None`` when no
distance was measured.
Assignment.title: Assignment

DerivedRadius.description: A date's match radius (meters) derived from the positioning error its photographs report.
DerivedRadius.title: DerivedRadius

PlantRegistryReference.description: A registered plant registry (:class:`PlantRegistry`) by name and content digest.
PlantRegistryReference.title: PlantRegistryReference

StatedRadius.description: A match radius (meters) a mapping build states for its captures, and how it is known.
StatedRadius.title: StatedRadius

tcip_mcp.pipelines.postprocessing.plant_.description:
One build's provenance plus its per-date assignments: the whole persisted record, in memory.

``dataset_id`` is the dataset identity record's minted id; ``dataset_root`` is spelled
against the owning project by :func:`~tcip_mcp.registry_paths.stored_path`.
``capture_digests`` is the identity of the captures each date was built from
(:func:`capture_digests`, one entry per stem), and ``match_radius`` the radius each date's
positioned captures were matched within (:func:`date_match_radius`): every date the build
walked when one was stated, and a date with no positioned capture has no derived one.
tcip_mcp.pipelines.postprocessing.plant_.title: MappingBuild

tcip_mcp.pipelines.postprocessing.plant_.description: The mapping a ``plant_mapping_built`` audit line's arguments name.
tcip_mcp.pipelines.postprocessing.plant_.title: _MappingBuilt

RegistryCsv.description: One plant-locations CSV a registry names: its path, content digest and plant count.
RegistryCsv.title: RegistryCsv

tcip_mcp.pipelines.postprocessing.plant_.description:
A plant registry record, the one :func:`plant_registry_key` stores.

It names its plant-locations CSVs, their ``crop`` and ``site``, the plant count, the content
digest over every parsed row and when it was registered.
tcip_mcp.pipelines.postprocessing.plant_.title: PlantRegistry

MaskCut.description:
How an instance segmentation head's soft masks become rings.

``mask_binarize`` is the probability a mask pixel is foreground at, refusing a value outside
``[0, 1]``, and ``vertex_spacing`` the pixels of each ring's perimeter per vertex its rings are
simplified to (``mask_contours.mask_to_polygon_rings``, zero keeping every contour vertex),
refusing a negative or non-finite value. Both are required.
MaskCut.title: MaskCut

ScoreWeights.description:
The composite objective's weight on each of its terms.

The objective is ``evaluation.compute_composite_objective``'s; each weight is non-negative so
a better term never raises the lower-is-better objective.
ScoreWeights.title: ScoreWeights

tcip_mcp.pipelines.schemas.EvaluationSpe.description:
What a run's validation pass scores against.

It holds the confirmed trait it selects for, the selection metric, one with a declared ranking
direction (:data:`SelectionMetric`), and the thresholds and score weights the validation pass
applies.
tcip_mcp.pipelines.schemas.EvaluationSpe.title: EvaluationSpec

Attribute.description:
One classification axis of a subject's instances.

``values`` are ordered, and a value's id is its position there; for an ``ordinal`` attribute
that order is the rank (severity 0 < 1 < 2). Construction validates every field
(``pydantic.ValidationError``): a known ``type`` and a non-empty list of distinct non-empty
names.
Attribute.title: Attribute

AugmentationSpec.description:
``augmentation``: each transform's name to the values its constructor takes.

Names are those ``augmentations.build_augmentation`` builds, kept as stated in order beside
the block's ``rationale``.
AugmentationSpec.title: AugmentationSpec

BoundSplit.description:
``data.split`` bound to the selection recorded at ``selection_dir``.

Its train and val sides are as recorded, or, with a ``seed`` stated, redrawn inside them at
it. The draw's reason is the selection's own record.
BoundSplit.title: BoundSplit

ClassScope.description:
The class space a run's ground truth was admitted under.

``subject`` is the object class a document admission read completion and targets for, and
``attributes`` every attribute the registry declares for it, each an
:class:`~tcip_mcp.subject_registry.Attribute` whose value ids are positions in its declared
order: ``None`` until the registry is read, empty for a subject that declares none. A mask
raster and a table row carry their own classes: the scope over them has every field
``None``. An empty subject is ``None``.
ClassScope.title: ClassScope

CosineSchedule.description: Cosine annealing over the block's horizon down to ``eta_min``.
CosineSchedule.title: CosineSchedule

DataSpec.description:
``data``: where a run's samples are and how they split.

It also holds what the run's resolution records beside them (``scope`` and the sizes). A key
outside these fields refuses by name, and so does a ``tiling`` beside a ``dataset_source``.
DataSpec.title: DataSpec

DatasetSourceSchema.description:
A bespoke dataset builder.

A key outside these fields refuses by name, and so does a ``builder_kwargs`` naming a value
the platform hands (:class:`DatasetContext`).
DatasetSourceSchema.title: DatasetSourceSchema

DrawnSplit.description:
``data.split`` a run draws itself at ``seed``.

Each side but ``train`` is drawn at its stated ``<side>_ratio`` (zero draws no such side,
``train`` the remainder), balanced by foreground count when ``stratify_foreground``, grouped
by ``grouping``: a named policy, or an explicit ``{<capture>/<stem>: group_key}`` map covering
every member.
DrawnSplit.title: DrawnSplit

EarlyStoppingSpec.description:
The stop rule that ends a stage and the run.

A stage ends once its selection value has not improved by ``min_delta`` for ``patience``
epochs, the run ends with the stage whose best does not improve by ``min_delta`` on the best of
the stage before it, and the run stops as diverged after ``nonfinite_passes`` consecutive full
training passes with no finite batch loss.
EarlyStoppingSpec.title: EarlyStoppingSpec

EvaluationSpec.description:
What a run's validation pass scores against.

It holds the confirmed trait it selects for, the selection metric, one with a declared ranking
direction (:data:`SelectionMetric`), and the thresholds and score weights the validation pass
applies.
EvaluationSpec.title: EvaluationSpec

ImageStatsSampling.description:
What band statistics read.

It is the sampling of whichever of ``derivations.band_normalization_stats`` (the exact
derivation) or ``band_normalization_stats_sampled`` (the windowed one) produced them.
``windows`` pairs each source's label with the rectangle read from it, or ``None`` for the
exact derivation's own whole-image read (``pixel_fraction`` is then ``1.0`` and
``window_size``/``max_windows_per_image`` are ``None``); ``max_images`` is the cap on rasters
drawn and ``seed`` the seed that drew them.
ImageStatsSampling.title: ImageStatsSampling

ImageStatsWindow.description: One pixel rectangle a sampled band-normalization statistic read, in a raster's own grid.
ImageStatsWindow.title: ImageStatsWindow

LrScalingSpec.description:
Effective-batch LR scaling.

Each stage's learning rates are multiplied by ``(its effective batch / the first stage's) **
scale_power``, capped at ``max_lr`` when one is stated.
LrScalingSpec.title: LrScalingSpec

MaskCut.description:
How an instance segmentation head's soft masks become rings.

``mask_binarize`` is the probability a mask pixel is foreground at, refusing a value outside
``[0, 1]``, and ``vertex_spacing`` the pixels of each ring's perimeter per vertex its rings are
simplified to (``mask_contours.mask_to_polygon_rings``, zero keeping every contour vertex),
refusing a negative or non-finite value. Both are required.
MaskCut.title: MaskCut

ModelSourceSchema.description:
The importable-builder reference and what its model is built with.

It holds the task its model is for, the statistics it normalizes by (whose source names any
pretrained weights its builder loads), and a detector's geometry stated for a run that
resolves no frame to derive it from. A key outside these fields refuses by name, and so does
a ``builder_kwargs`` naming a value the platform hands (:data:`HANDED_TO_BUILDER`).
ModelSourceSchema.title: ModelSourceSchema

Normalization.description:
The per-band ``image_mean`` and ``image_std`` a model normalizes its input by.

Both are in [0, 1] tensor units. Their ``source`` is the data's band statistics' own sampling
record when no weights load (``derivations.band_normalization_stats``), the pretrained weights
whose own statistics they are (``derivations.pretrained_normalization``), or the statement of
every band for a model reading more bands than its weights carry statistics for.
Normalization.title: Normalization

OneCycleSchedule.description:
One cycle over the block's horizon peaking at ``max_lr``.

Each of ``torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR``'s own settings is stated.
OneCycleSchedule.title: OneCycleSchedule

OptimizerSpec.description:
Optimizer settings.

Its family and its tuned settings are required (both rates, the weight decay, and ``momentum``
for ``sgd`` and for no other optimizer).
OptimizerSpec.title: OptimizerSpec

PlateauSchedule.description:
The rate times ``factor`` once the run's selection value stops improving.

It stops improving when it has not improved in its metric's direction (:func:`selection_of`),
by ``threshold`` in ``threshold_mode``, for ``patience`` epochs; ``cooldown`` epochs then pass
before the count resumes. The rate never falls below ``min_lr``, and a change smaller than
``eps`` is not applied (``torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau``).
PlateauSchedule.title: PlateauSchedule

PretrainedWeights.description:
Pretrained weights a model's builder loads.

They are named by the ``library`` publishing them and their ``name`` there, a timm pretrained
tag (``resnet18.a1_in1k``), a torchvision weights enum member
(``ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1``) or a ``transformers`` checkpoint, a Hugging Face hub id
(``facebook/mask2former-swin-small-coco-instance``) or a directory holding one.
PretrainedWeights.title: PretrainedWeights

SamplerSpec.description:
``sampler``: the train loader's sampler ``name`` names (``samplers.build_sampler``).

The sampler's own values are kept as stated beside the block's ``rationale``.
SamplerSpec.title: SamplerSpec

ScoreWeights.description:
The composite objective's weight on each of its terms.

The objective is ``evaluation.compute_composite_objective``'s; each weight is non-negative so
a better term never raises the lower-is-better objective.
ScoreWeights.title: ScoreWeights

StageSpec.description:
One progressive-unfreeze step.

It holds ``freeze_to`` and ``gradient_accumulation_steps``. Any other key, a per-stage ``lr``
or ``epochs`` included, is refused by name.
StageSpec.title: StageSpec

StatedBeyondWeights.description:
Per-band statistics stated with ``rationale`` beyond the bands the weights cover.

The model reads more bands than the ``pretrained_weights`` it loads carry statistics for.
StatedBeyondWeights.title: StatedBeyondWeights

StatedDetectorGeometry.description: A detector geometry a model source states, with its reason.
StatedDetectorGeometry.title: StatedDetectorGeometry

TilingSpec.description:
``data.tiling``, stated for a run that tiles its loader (:func:`run_tiling`).

It holds the ``datasets.TiledDetectionDataset`` options it states (an unstated edge and
overlap derived, an unstated sliver fraction derived by the tiler), whether a tile holding no
object trains (``skip_empty``), and a within-image spatial split's ``buffer``.
TilingSpec.title: TilingSpec

_Stated.description:
A block a config states.

A key outside its fields refuses by name, and ``rationale`` carries why the block states what
it does.
_Stated.title: _Stated

tcip_mcp.pipelines.schemas.TrainConfigSc.description:
The training config shape: trainer keys at the top level, no nested section.

A key outside these fields is a bespoke loop's own and is kept as stated. It requires
``model_source``, ``data``, ``evaluation``, the seeding and precision every trainer reads, and
``rationale``, the reason for the top-level values it states; what training reads besides is
:meth:`trainer_reads`.
tcip_mcp.pipelines.schemas.TrainConfigSc.title: TrainConfigSchema

RangeStop.description:
Where a range test stopped short of its last step, and why.

``step`` is the one-based optimizer step it stopped at, which logged no row.
RangeStop.title: RangeStop

tcip_mcp.pipelines.training.lr_range.LrR.description:
A range test's reading of its curve, its run's ``lr_range.json``.

It holds where the test stopped (``None`` for a ramp run to its last step), the trainable
parameter count and the ``freeze_to`` of the stage it probed, the ``backbone_lr / head_lr``
ratio its groups were ramped under, the head rate of minimum smoothed loss and the head rate
of steepest descent (the least slope of the smoothed loss over the log rate).

The range is derived from those, never stored beside them, by a rule that is provisional
until a validation on this platform's data replaces it: :attr:`high` is the rate of minimum
smoothed loss (Smith 2018, arXiv 1803.09820, section 4.1: the rate at that extremum is the
